veranderings.na: Sy plek in die prent tel ook as
veranderings.rede: 'Sy plek tel ook' is wooden and vague on its own; naming where the place is makes it clear the grasshopper's position in the picture is meant.

veranderings.voor: na daardie kake wat na bo buig
veranderings.na: na die kake wat boontoe buig
veranderings.rede: 'daardie' sounds stiff when referring back to the jaws just named, and 'boontoe buig' is more natural than 'na bo buig' and avoids the doubled 'na'.
